description: This file defines the NamedFormula class, which extends DefinedName to represent named formulas within a spreadsheet. It includes methods for creating instances with specified formulas, retrieving the formula, and setting the formula value.
external_files: PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\DefinedName (assumed to be in the same namespace or included elsewhere)

classes.name: NamedFormula
classes.description: Represents a named formula within a spreadsheet, extends DefinedName, with methods to get and set the formula

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for NamedFormula, initializes with name, optional worksheet, formula, scope, and localOnly flag; throws exception if formula is not provided.

methods.name: getFormula
methods.description: Returns the formula string stored in the named formula.

methods.name: setFormula
methods.description: Sets the formula string for the named formula, returns self for method chaining.
